插件可以提供设置页面并响应手势事件。Studio 为每个插件分配独立的数据目录。: Plugins can add a settings page and respond to gesture events. Studio assigns each plugin its own data folder.
表单由插件声明，Studio 负责显示和保存。: The plugin declares this form; Studio displays and saves it.
手势名称和时间戳，不含原始 IMU 数据。: Gesture names and timestamps; no raw IMU data.
用手势控制系统媒体的播放、切歌和音量。: Control system media playback, tracks and volume with gestures.
向操作系统发送媒体按键。: Sends media keys to the operating system.
把识别到的手势发送到你配置的 HTTP 地址，用于连接自动化服务。: Sends recognized gestures to an HTTP address you configure, for automation services.
只有识别结果会发送到这个地址。: Only recognition results are sent to this address.
向你配置的地址发送数据。: Sends data to the address you configure.
演示时用手势翻到上一页或下一页。: Move to the previous or next slide with gestures while presenting.
清单声明的入口文件 main.py 不存在。: The entry file main.py declared in the manifest does not exist.
末页后回到首页: Return to first slide after the last
向当前窗口发送翻页按键。: Sends page keys to the active window.
用手势开始或结束一段专注计时，并把记录保存到自己的数据目录。: Start or stop a focus session with gestures and keep records in its own data folder.
将清空 {name} 的数据目录和缓存目录，设置和手势绑定不受影响。此操作无法撤: This empties the data and cache folders of {name}. Settings and gesture bindings are kept. This cannot be undone.
将取消注册 {name}，并删除 Studio 分配给它的目录（{size}）。: This unregisters {name} and deletes the folders Studio assigned to it ({size}). This cannot be undone.
本地目录中的插件不会自动更新；修改代码后请重新加载。: Plugins from a local folder do not update automatically; reload after changing the code.
新版本新增权限：{permissions}。需要你确认后才会安装。: New permissions in this version: {permissions}. It will be installed only after you confirm.
修复切歌时偶尔重复触发的问题；新增静音动作。: Fixes occasional double track changes and adds a mute action.
支持把事件写入本地队列，网络恢复后补发。: Queues events locally and resends them when the network returns.
Studio 窗口关闭时继续补发事件。: Keeps resending events after the Studio window closes.
{name} v{version} 新增权限：{permissions}。同意后: {name} v{version} adds these permissions: {permissions}. The update is installed only if you agree.
Python 插件以你的账户权限运行，可访问文件和网络。独立进程、虚拟环境和数据: Python plugins run with your account's permissions and can access files and the network. Separate processes, virtual environments and data folders are not a security sandbox. Run only code you trust; trust must be confirmed on first enable and after code changes.
服务与手势控制默认关闭。开机加载仅在你明确开启后生效。: The service and gesture control are off by default. Loading at startup requires your explicit opt-in.
表单由插件声明。修改后点击保存；动作参数在各条手势绑定中单独配置。: The plugin declares this form. Save your changes; action parameters are configured separately for each gesture binding.
一个手势可以触发多个动作。绑定按模型内容指纹保存；其他模型的绑定保留，但不会由当: One gesture can trigger multiple actions. Bindings are saved by model content fingerprint. Bindings for other models are kept but cannot be triggered by the current model.
无需手势绑定，使用动作参数默认值测试。测试会真实执行插件代码；绑定中的测试使用该: Test with default action parameters, without a gesture binding. Tests execute real plugin code; tests within a binding use that binding's current parameters.
启用后，插件可收到完整保存的录音文件，并可能上传文件。请核实用途和接收方；开启订: When enabled, the plugin can receive fully saved recording files and may upload them. Check their intended use and recipient. Enabling a subscription or widening its scope requires separate confirmation.
仅此插件发起的录音: Recordings started by this plugin only
选择已有音频并发送事件…: Choose an audio file and send an event…
Studio 为每个插件分配数据目录，便于管理；这不限制 Python 插件访问: Studio assigns each plugin a data folder for organization. This does not restrict Python plugins from accessing other files.
不会自动更新或安装依赖。修改本地代码后请重新加载；GitHub 更新下载并运行所: Updates and dependency installation are never automatic. Reload after changing local code. GitHub updates download and run the exact commit shown.
此插件没有可测试的动作。: This plugin has no actions to test.
不活跃：不属于当前模型（保留绑定）: Inactive: belongs to another model (binding kept)
此插件未声明事件订阅。: This plugin declares no event subscriptions.
此插件将以你的账户权限执行 Python，可读写文件、联网和运行程序。独立进程不: This plugin will execute Python with your account's permissions. It can read and write files, access the network and run programs. A separate process is not a security sandbox, and declared permissions cannot stop malicious code. Run only plugins you trust.
正在下载固定版本并读取清单…: Downloading the pinned version and reading its manifest…
已安装 {name}；请显式准备运行环境后启用。: Installed {name}. Prepare its runtime environment before enabling it.
更新清单的插件标识不匹配，已拒绝。: The plugin ID in the update manifest does not match. The update was rejected.
安装后插件将暂停，确认信任新代码后才能重新启用。: The plugin will be paused after installation. You must confirm that you trust the new code before enabling it again.
更新已安装；请准备依赖并确认后重新启用。: Update installed. Prepare dependencies and confirm before enabling the plugin again.
插件运行环境已准备完成。: The plugin runtime environment is ready.
请先点击“准备运行环境”，不会在启动时自动安装依赖。: Click “Prepare runtime environment” first. Dependencies are not installed automatically at startup.
当前平台不支持此插件。: This plugin is not supported on the current platform.
请先启动插件服务，并连接设备开启有效模型的实时识别。: Start the plugin service, connect a device and enable live recognition with a valid model first.
无法确定模型指纹，插件手势控制不可用：{error}: Could not determine the model fingerprint. Plugin gesture control is unavailable: {error}
此手势已有动作: This gesture already has an action
继续添加会同时触发多个动作。继续？: Adding another action will trigger multiple actions at the same time. Continue?
冷却时间必须是 0 到 3600000 毫秒的整数。: Cooldown must be an integer from 0 to 3,600,000 milliseconds.
将其他模型的同名手势绑定复制到当前模型，不会修改原绑定。请检查动作是否合适。: Bindings for gestures with matching names will be copied from other models to the current model. Original bindings will not be changed. Check that the actions are appropriate.
按同名手势复制绑定？: Copy bindings for matching gesture names?
测试会产生真实的键盘、网络或录音操作，不是模拟运行。: This test performs real keyboard, network or recording operations. It is not a simulation.
测试会使用默认动作参数并产生真实副作用。: This test uses default action parameters and produces real side effects.
允许插件读取录音文件？: Allow the plugin to read recording files?
插件将收到新录音的文件路径，并能读取完整音频。若插件会上传，请先确认设置中的目标: The plugin will receive file paths for new recordings and can read the full audio. If it uploads recordings, first confirm the destination and intended use in its settings. This subscription switch does not impose security restrictions on arbitrary Python code.
包括界面或其他插件发起的新录音。不回放历史录音；请确认上传目的地和处理用途。: This includes new recordings started from the interface or by other plugins. Past recordings will not be replayed. Confirm the upload destination and intended processing purpose.
将此音频交给插件处理？: Let the plugin process this audio?
插件可以读取文件并执行真实操作，包括自行上传。文件：{path}: The plugin can read this file and perform real operations, including uploading it on its own. File: {path}
先停止并等待完整保存，再执行此操作？: Stop recording and wait for it to be fully saved before proceeding?
录音正在启动或保存，请等待状态稳定后重试。: Recording is starting or being saved. Wait for the state to settle, then try again.
将永久清空数据与缓存，保留设置和绑定。: Data and cache will be permanently cleared. Settings and bindings will be kept.
将删除插件托管代码、环境、数据、设置、绑定和密钥。不会删除原始来源目录。: The plugin's Studio-managed code, environment, data, settings, bindings and secrets will be deleted. The original source folder will not be deleted.
请先连接设备并等待 IMU 恢复上报；维护或手势采集期间不能试识别。: Connect the device and wait for IMU data reporting to resume. Test recognition is unavailable during maintenance or gesture capture.
无法自动恢复已绑定模型，请重新导入后绑定：{error}: Could not restore the bound model. Import it again and create a binding: {error}
无法自动保存绑定模型：{error}: Could not automatically save the bound model: {error}
当前模型已失效或正在训练，不能保存绑定。: The current model is stale or training is in progress. The binding cannot be saved.
已自动保存绑定模型：{path}；下次启动将自动恢复。: Bound model saved automatically: {path}. It will be restored at the next startup.
首次成功绑定会自动保存模型；下次启动恢复最近使用的已绑定模型，无需重新导入。识别: The first successful binding saves a model snapshot. The most recently used bound model is restored at startup, without importing it again. Recognition and gesture control must still be enabled manually.
成功绑定后自动保存: Saved automatically after a successful binding
